headline: Armor Extends its Security Portfolio with Palo Alto Networks RedLock, a Cloud Security Posture Management Offering
summary:
Dallas, April  03, 2019  (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Armor®, a leading cloud security solutions provider, announced today that it is launching Armor Automated Security and Compliance – RedLock.

RedLock® from Palo Alto Networks ((NYSE:PANW)) is a continuous cloud security and compliance posture management offering for public and multi-cloud environments.
